name: allele_dosage
code_version_note: the commit at build time, which precedes the commit that lands this file

inputs.role: the NMD verdict and truncation, which set the stop allele's factors
the readthrough fraction used in the treated scenarios; only rows whose positive control passed are read
the published MVA missense alleles behind the unstable/inactive branches

parameters.model: per allele, 0.5 x mrna x protein_per_mrna x full_length x specific_activity
parameters.threshold_resolution: two rungs only: BLM has no published graded hypomorph series, so a scenario between 0 % and 50 % has no published genotype to be read against

assumptions: BLM function is proportional to the amount of working helicase and the two alleles add; the healthy carrier state (50 %) is the target a treatment would aim at
limitations: no BLM protein level has been measured for the modelled genotype, and the disease has no published graded hypomorph series, so every intermediate total lands between two rungs with nothing published in between; the NMD-escape and product-activity factors are stated assumptions carried over from the BUB1B card, not BLM measurements
validation: the untreated homozygote must land at the syndrome rung and the carrier at the healthy rung, which is the only calibration the published genotypes support

sources.literature: PMID:39174735 (measured readthrough, 5,837 pathogenic PTCs); PMID:4140506, PMID:7585968, PMID:17407155 (Bloom syndrome genotype-phenotype)
sources.clinical: none: this is a transfer case used to measure the route's portability. No patient of this project has Bloom syndrome and no HPO term is read here
sources.genomic: a published allele of the BLM gene, read from the literature; no callset, no genomic position, no patient sequence
sources.public: Ensembl REST (transcript model, CDS) and UniProt P54132 (domains)

columns.total_pct_of_wild_type: percent of the wild-type diploid amount of working BLM
columns.gain_pct_points: percentage points this scenario's drug adds over the same scenario untreated
columns.nearest_published_genotype: the published genotype whose level is closest, as a yardstick only

clinical_framing: research exercise; no row advises for or against giving any drug to any patient
patient_data: none in this file. Sequence-derived facts are stated as codon identity, exon index, counts and fractions; no genomic position and no run of patient sequence appears
